instagram.caption:
Nintendo is over 130 years old. It started by selling playing cards.

It was founded in Kyoto in 1889 to make handmade hanafuda cards, and it still sells them today.

Before video games it also tried a taxi company, instant rice and toys. Donkey Kong, its first big hit, came 92 years in.
